implementation_notes: Team-designed resolution/LR ladder, implemented within the Aegis project.
Use all 148695 audited official training rows with original labels.
Use the frozen grouped 133815/14880 project split for dev stages.
Use original images and project-native OpenAI CLIP.
Starting hyperparameters are not measured optima. Microbatch2 and activation checkpointing require local CUDA cost/memory validation.
Final five-epoch full-data stage includes former holdout; no independent validation, one raw last checkpoint.
User enabled training-side EMA on 2026-09-29; dev stages inherit the selected single raw/EMA state, final inference uses raw last.
All four stages start with or inherit a direct 768-dimensional CLS head; the 768-to-512 projection is removed.
Full official initialization, not the previously closed S3-to-768 short continuation.
Readout is FP32 in this explicit route, while the visual tower uses the original BF16 training policy.
Implementation preparation alone does not start the long training controller.
